section_obstruction.theorem: A non-premise absolute polarity would have to descend to the simultaneous-flip quotient, so it must satisfy s(x)=s(Fx).  A sourced sign-line response to the missing torsor would have to be anti-equivariant, so it must satisfy s(x)=-s(Fx).  The combined rational linear system has rank 16 and nullity 0, and the {±1}-valued cross-check has zero simultaneous sections.  Thus the quotient has no nonzero sign-line section capable of fixing lambda/P2721.
